quarterly_data.quarter: Xanadu press release: Xanadu Secures Up to USD $10 Million in Additional DARPA (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Xanadu received provisional approval for project funding worth up to USD $10 million under DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI), a one-year contract extension building on its Stage B work; over the next 12 months it will report progress to DARPA and allocate the majority of the funding to critical components of its R&D roadmap.
quarterly_data.figure: up to USD $10 million (one-year QBI contract extension)
